people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
translations.bsb: Israel is swallowed up! Now they are among the nations like a worthless vessel.
translations.kjv: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
translations.asv: Israel is swallowed up: now are they among the nations as a vessel wherein none delighteth.
